Implemented the bounded real-positive Hankel recurrence in bessel.rs. It applies for 0.5 ≤ x ≤ 10⁴, through degree 64; other arguments retain AMOS.

Verified:

  • All 52 focused special-function tests passed.
  • An additional compiled Rust test passed against six independent 90-digit references.
  • Reference, physical flux/Wronskian, and argument-gradient tests retain their tolerances.
  • The independent Python prototype covered 948 arguments and 184,860 jet components: maximum normalized error 7.23e-15, below 1e-13; all results finite.

Evidence: qualification script, summary.

The initial physical-test failure also occurs with the original AMOS Hankel sequence; its source was AMOS’s regular-J derivative. The revised test uses well-conditioned identities in each region, preserves the regression seed, and changes no tolerances.

No extension builds, timing measurements, commits, pushes, or PR changes performed. Production source is frozen.
